newsitem.title: USA: Zygo receives Lawrence Livermore contract.
newsitem.headline: Zygo receives Lawrence Livermore contract.

text.p: Zygo Corp said the University of Califonia's Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory has selected Zygo to supply large plano optical compnents for the Laboratory's National Ignition Facility.
The National Ignition Facility is a Department of Energy project for the production of a laser for nuclear fusion research.
Under the contract, Zygo will design, manufacture and equip an optical fabrication facility for a fixed price of nearly $10 million over an 18-month period.

The company said that the contract is presently funded to slightly in excess of $5.5 million and, consistent with other government contracts, requires additional appropriations from the U.S. Congress prior to the company's receiving additional funding.
Zygo said that the final aspect of the contract contemplates the negotiation of another contract to produce optical components and could have a value of approximately $15 million to the company.
Zygo Corp designs, develops, manufactures and markets precision measurement and automation systems and components.
